grok-4.5.gpt-4o-mini: Severely abridged summary that omits core source sequences and reduces the story to thin narrator bridges; scenes are not broken into discrete 5-10s visual beats and character re-appearances lack locked descriptions, rendering it unusable for clip production.
grok-4.5.gpt-5.6-terra: Nearly complete, accurate translation of every major book beat and line of dialogue with concrete, single-location visual actions ideal for short AI clips; character looks are established early and held; only weakness is total absence of explicit music/sound-bed prompts.
grok-4.5.grok-4.5: Most exhaustive and precise adaptation: every source beat, sensory detail and line is preserved as discrete, camera-ready actions with consistent, lockable character descriptions (Boy fair hair/nightshirt, Nana starched apron, Rabbit progressive shabbiness); emotional arcs are crystal-clear for later music scoring even without explicit cues.
grok-4.5.gemini-3.6-flash: Invented proper names and dialogue plus structural reordering trigger severe fidelity penalty; remaining visuals are serviceable but the script cannot be green-lit as a faithful adaptation.
grok-4.5.grok-4: Bare-bones condensation that loses most of the book’s emotional texture and visual specificity; too many multi-beat summaries and missing character locks make it unsuitable for per-clip AI generation.
grok-4.5.gemini-2.5-flash: Faithful, well-paced coverage of virtually all source incidents with clear visual staging and authentic dialogue; character descriptions are solid and recurring; only minor shortfall is lack of music/sound prompts and slightly less granular action lines than top contenders.

grok-4.5.gpt-5.6-sol: Visually rich and clip-friendly staging is undermined by severe fidelity violation through invented proper names and non-source dialogue; cannot be green-lit as an adaptation of the book.
